dialogue.origin: こんばんは、相談員です。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm a counselor here. What can I help you with today?

dialogue.origin: (よろしくお願いいたします)
dialogue.content: (I look forward to working with you.)

dialogue.origin: 不妊について悩んでます
dialogue.content: I’m struggling with infertility.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、それは大切なお話ですね。
dialogue.content: I see. That's a very important thing to talk about.

dialogue.origin: どのような状況なのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me more about your situation?

dialogue.origin: 親からも親戚からも姉たちからも近所の方からも、まだかまだかとせっつかれ精神的にキツいです
dialogue.content: My parents, relatives, sisters, and even my neighbors keep pressing me, asking, “Isn’t it time yet?” It’s mentally exhausting.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか…それは辛い…
dialogue.content: I see... that must be so difficult...

dialogue.origin: 焦ってしまいますよね…
dialogue.content: It must make you feel anxious, doesn't it...

dialogue.origin: 毎月、月のものが来てしまうと絶望感でいっぱいです
dialogue.content: Every month, when my period comes, I'm filled with a sense of despair.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか…
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 毎月悲しさが来るのは心苦しいですよね…
dialogue.content: It must be heartbreaking to feel that sadness every month...

dialogue.origin: 挙句に夫はそんなに欲しいなら他の男に抱かれて来いと
dialogue.content: On top of that, my husband said, “If you want a child that badly, go sleep with another man.”

dialogue.origin: そんな…
dialogue.content: Oh, my...

dialogue.origin: 夫さんには味方になってほしいですよね…
dialogue.content: You'd want your husband to be on your side, wouldn't you...

dialogue.origin: どのくらいの期間そのような状況が続いているのですか？
dialogue.content: How long has this situation been going on?

dialogue.origin: 顔をみるのも嫌な位、嫌悪感ですがこんな私と結婚してくれたので
dialogue.content: I feel such aversion that I can't even stand to look at his face, but he did marry someone like me, so...

dialogue.origin: そう思ってらっしゃるのですね…
dialogue.content: That's how you feel, isn't it...

dialogue.origin: 上の子が3歳なので2年間です
dialogue.content: Our older child is three, so it's been for two years.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか…
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんは二年前からそのような感じなのですか？
dialogue.content: Has your husband been like that for the past two years?

dialogue.origin: 優しい時もありますが、基本育児も家事も全く無関心で全て私任せです
dialogue.content: He has his kind moments, but basically, he's completely indifferent to childcare and housework, leaving it all to me.

dialogue.origin: そうですか…いっぱいいっぱいになってしまいますね…
dialogue.content: I see... you must be feeling completely overwhelmed...

dialogue.origin: 家出したくなった事もありますが、私は皆に尽くさなければ…沢山迷惑かけてきているので
dialogue.content: There have been times when I've wanted to run away from home, but I feel I have to do everything for everyone... because I've caused so much trouble.

dialogue.origin: そう思われているのですね…それは追い詰められてしまいますね
dialogue.content: That’s how you’ve been feeling… anyone would feel cornered in that situation.

dialogue.origin: 迷惑というのは…なにがあったんですか？
dialogue.content: When you say “trouble”… what happened?

dialogue.origin: 旦那は、家族を捨ててまで私を選んでくれ前の職場も辞めて私の実家の仕事をしてくれてます
dialogue.content: My husband chose me, even leaving his family behind. He also quit his previous job and now works for my family's business.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。それは借りを作ってしまった気分になりますよね…
dialogue.content: I see. That must make you feel like you're indebted to him...

dialogue.origin: 夫さんは、ご家族や職場とはなぜ離れられたのですか？
dialogue.content: Why did your husband leave his family and his job?

dialogue.origin: はいただ、今は私にも子供にも興味が無い気がして
dialogue.content: Yes... but now, I feel like he's not interested in me or our child.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね…それは一方通行な感じがして辛いですよね。。
dialogue.content: I see... It must be painful to feel like it's a one-way street.

dialogue.origin: 今少しお話を伺い、夫さんとの関係で悩んでいるようにお見受けしますが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: From what you’ve shared, it sounds like you’re struggling with your relationship with your husband. Does that sound right?

dialogue.origin: 旦那の両親が私を嫌いで元彼女とでなければ結婚は許さないとで、彼は全てを捨て私の実家に入ってくれました勿論、結婚式には旦那の両親は不参加です
dialogue.content: My husband's parents disliked me and said they wouldn't permit the marriage unless it was with his ex-girlfriend, so he gave everything up to join my family. Of course, his parents didn't attend our wedding.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね…
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 旦那は、優しい所も沢山あるので大丈夫なんですが、次の子はまだかまだか、と周りに言われる事が1番辛いです
dialogue.content: My husband has many kind sides, so that's okay, but the most painful thing is being asked by everyone around me when the next child is coming.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、それは悩みますよね…
dialogue.content: I see, that must be very distressing...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 悩みと言うかもう言わないで欲しい
dialogue.content: It’s less a “concern” and more that I just want them to stop saying it.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、言われたくないですよね
dialogue.content: Of course. You don't want to hear that.

dialogue.origin: 言われて毎月絶望感を感じるのも悲しいですものね…
dialogue.content: Being told that and then feeling despair every month is heartbreaking…

dialogue.origin: 私も次の子は早く欲しいですでも、自分が焦ってるのに周りからも言われると凄くシンドいです
dialogue.content: I also want another child as soon as possible. But I’m already feeling anxious, and when people around me say things too, it becomes extremely tough.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんのご家族とは縁を切っているとのことですが、
dialogue.content: You mentioned that you've cut ties with your husband's family...

dialogue.origin: かぶってしまいましたね、
dialogue.content: Oh, sorry, we spoke at the same time.

dialogue.origin: それはしんどいと思われるのも無理ないです…
dialogue.content: It’s completely understandable that you’d find that exhausting…

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんのご家族は縁を切ってるとのことでしたが、どなたから言われるのが気になっていますか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned you've cut ties with your husband's family, so who is it that's making these comments that bother you?

dialogue.origin: 生まれた長女を一目見てもらいたいと私の願望なんですが、嫌いな女が産んだ孫はみたくないか。とも
dialogue.content: It's my wish for them to see our firstborn daughter just once, but I also wonder if they don't want to see the grandchild of a woman they hate.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんのご両親にお見せしたいのですね。
dialogue.content: You would like to show her to your husband’s parents.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: もしかしたら、次のお子様が生まれたらそのきっかけがつかめるかもとの思いもあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is there also a hope that, if you had another child, it might become a chance to reconnect?

dialogue.origin: それは逆にないですね
dialogue.content: Actually, it's the opposite.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 子供が欲しいのは
dialogue.content: The reason I want a child is...

dialogue.origin: えぇ
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 自分が欲しい気持ちと上の子に下の子を授けてあげたい。と2点が大きいですね
dialogue.content: There are two main reasons: I personally want one, and I want to give our older child a younger sibling.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: だけど
dialogue.content: But...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: 周りから、やんややんや言われるのはキツいです
dialogue.content: It's tough being nagged and pressured by everyone around me.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、周りから言われるのは嫌ですよね
dialogue.content: Right, it’s unpleasant to hear that from others.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どなたから言われるのが気になりますか？
dialogue.content: Whose comments weigh on you the most?

dialogue.origin: 誰と言うより私の顔見て言う人の人数の多さですね
dialogue.content: It's not so much about who, but the sheer number of people who say it to my face.

dialogue.origin: 言ってくる方が沢山いるんですね…
dialogue.content: So there are many people who say these things to you…

dialogue.origin: それは気になりますよね
dialogue.content: That would really weigh on you.

dialogue.origin: どんなことを言われるのが一番気になりますか？
dialogue.content: What kinds of comments bother you the most?

dialogue.origin: 最初にも言いましたが、両親、親戚、姉たち、近所の人たち軽く30日超えです
dialogue.content: Like I said at the beginning, my parents, relatives, sisters, neighbors... it's easily over 30 people.

dialogue.origin: そんなに…
dialogue.content: That many...?

dialogue.origin: 30人です
dialogue.content: Thirty people.

dialogue.origin: 多いですね…それは、もうほっといてって思いますね
dialogue.content: That’s a lot… It would make you want to say, “Just leave me alone.”

dialogue.origin: そうなんです自分が一番焦ってるのに…
dialogue.content: Exactly. I’m the one who’s most anxious about it...

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: Right.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: いわれなくても十分わかってるよ！っておもいますよね
dialogue.content: You must feel like saying, “I already know that without you telling me!” don’t you?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どんなことを言われるのが一番気になりますか？
dialogue.content: What kind of comments bother you the most?

dialogue.origin: 今月いけそう？本当に頑張ってるの？とかですね
dialogue.content: Things like, “Any luck this month?” or “Are you really even trying?”

dialogue.origin: そうですか…
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: もう十分頑張っているのに…
dialogue.content: Even though you’re already doing more than enough…

dialogue.origin: 泣
dialogue.content: (cries)

dialogue.origin: 認められてないように感じますよね…
dialogue.content: It makes you feel like your efforts aren't being acknowledged...

dialogue.origin: 何だか妖怪に見えてきてます
dialogue.content: They’re starting to look like monsters to me.

dialogue.origin: 人じゃない…
dialogue.content: Not human...

dialogue.origin: そうですか…
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: やんや妖怪ですね…
dialogue.content: The Nag-Nag Monster, right…

dialogue.origin: そうですね！やんや妖怪！！
dialogue.content: Yes! The Nag-Nag Monster!!

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、もう十分やっているよと叫びたいくらいですね！
dialogue.content: Exactly. You must feel like shouting, “I’m already doing everything I can!”

dialogue.origin: はい！！
dialogue.content: Yes!!

dialogue.origin: そうですよね！ちなみに、お医者様とはどんなお話しをされているのですか？
dialogue.content: Exactly! By the way, what kind of conversations have you had with your doctor?

dialogue.origin: あまり協力的でなく、私の辛さを訴えてるのに授かりものなんだから。と
dialogue.content: He's not very supportive. Even when I tell him how much I'm struggling, he just says, “Children are a blessing, you know.”

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか…
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 一番頼りたい人なのに…
dialogue.content: And that’s the person you most want to rely on…

dialogue.origin: 病院も変えようと思った事もあるのですが色々とあって仕方なしです
dialogue.content: I’ve thought about changing hospitals, but for various reasons, I have no choice.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、変えるのは難しかったのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. Has it been difficult to change?

dialogue.origin: 家事と実家の仕事と娘の送り迎えを考えると移動距離がどうしてもそこしかなくて
dialogue.content: When I think about housework, working for my family's business, and picking up and dropping off my daughter, that's the only place within a reasonable travel distance.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね…
dialogue.content: I understand...

dialogue.origin: それは生活と思いの板挟みですね…
dialogue.content: So you're caught between your life's practicalities and your feelings...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 相談者さん、ここまでのお話をまとめさせていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Would it be all right if I summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご相談者さんは、3歳のお子様と夫さんがいて、下のお子様ができないことで、周りの方に色々と言われることに悩んでらっしゃいます。
dialogue.content: You have a three-year-old child and a husband, and you’re distressed by the things people around you are saying because you haven’t been able to have another child.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご相談者さんが基本育児も家事もしてらっしゃいます。
dialogue.content: You are the one primarily handling childcare and housework.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Right.

dialogue.origin: 旦那様は家族を捨て結婚してくれ、今はご実家の仕事を手伝ってらっしゃいます
dialogue.content: Your husband left his family to marry you, and he is now helping with your family's business.

dialogue.origin: そして不妊に関して、３０人くらいの方からやんや色々言われて辛い思いをしてらっしゃいます。
dialogue.content: And regarding infertility, about thirty people have been nagging you, which is causing you a lot of pain.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 一番頼りたい病院の先生も辛さをわかってくれず
dialogue.content: The doctor you most want to rely on doesn’t understand your distress,

dialogue.origin: 病院を変えるにも生活とのバランスが取れなくなっている
dialogue.content: and changing hospitals would throw your life out of balance.

dialogue.origin: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: (22時少し過ぎても大丈夫ですか？)
dialogue.content: (Is it alright if we go a little past 10 p.m.?)

dialogue.origin: 何だか私の取説みたいマスクに書いてあるこうかな
dialogue.content: It kind of feels like my instruction manual. Maybe I should write it on my mask.

dialogue.origin: （大丈夫です）
dialogue.content: (That's fine.)

dialogue.origin: マスクに！すごい発想力ですね！
dialogue.content: On your mask! What a creative idea!

dialogue.origin: (ありがとうございます！続けます！)
dialogue.content: (Thank you! I’ll continue!)

dialogue.origin: ご相談者さんは今まで2年間沢山頑張って
dialogue.content: You’ve worked so hard for these past two years,

dialogue.origin: 言う勇気は無いので、これを見れば皆が分かってくれたら嬉しいと思いました
dialogue.content: I don’t have the courage to say it aloud, so I thought if people could just read this, they’d understand.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね！
dialogue.content: I understand completely!

dialogue.origin: やんや言われながらも家庭と仕事、そして不妊治療を両立されてきました
dialogue.content: Even while people are nagging you, you’ve been juggling your home, work, and fertility treatments.

dialogue.origin: そんな大変な中なのに、上の子に下の子を作ってあげたい
dialogue.content: And in the midst of all that difficulty, you still want to give your older child a younger sibling.

dialogue.origin: はぃ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 取説まだ続きますか？
dialogue.content: Is there more to the instruction manual?

dialogue.origin: ここからは私が思ったことをお伝えしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: From here, may I share some of my own thoughts?

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: やんや言われながらも、上の子に下の子を作ってあげたい旦那さんは優しいところもある
dialogue.content: Despite the nagging, you want to give your older child a younger sibling, and your husband has his kind moments.

dialogue.origin: そんな風にご家族のことを考えるご相談者さんが、本当に優しくて誠実だと思いました
dialogue.content: Thinking about your family that way shows what a truly kind and sincere person you are.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございますそんな風に人から言われたのは初めてです
dialogue.content: Thank you... this is the first time anyone has ever said something like that to me.

dialogue.origin: もう十分すぎるくらい頑張っている、これ以上何を頑張れというのでしょう。
dialogue.content: You’re already doing more than enough—what more could anyone possibly ask you to do?

dialogue.origin: 一方で
dialogue.content: On the other hand,

dialogue.origin: やんやと沢山の人に言われることで、ご相談者さんは焦っていらっしゃいます。
dialogue.content: being nagged by so many people is making you feel anxious.

dialogue.origin: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: そんな感じです
dialogue.content: That's how it feels.

dialogue.origin: ここからはご提案なのですが…今の状況から少しでも抜け出せるように一緒に考えていければと思います。
dialogue.content: From this point, I have a suggestion. I’d like for us to think together about ways to help you break free from this situation, even just a little.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 旦那さんは家事育児をしないとのことでしたが…お優しいところもあるとのこと、家事分担など共に考えてみてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned your husband doesn't do housework or childcare... but you also said he has a kind side. How about trying to discuss sharing the household chores with him?

dialogue.origin: 例えば、家事をリスト化して、
dialogue.content: For example, you could make a list of the chores...

dialogue.origin: すみません
dialogue.content: Excuse me.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: ご提案ですので、是非一緒に考えていきましょう。
dialogue.content: It's just a suggestion, so please, let's think about it together.

dialogue.origin: なにか思うことがあったら教えてくださいね
dialogue.content: If anything comes to mind, please let me know.

dialogue.origin: 主人の不満は言いましたが、話しを聞いて頂いたら家事も育児も大丈夫です主人の気持ちがどこにあるか不安になっただけだと気が付きました
dialogue.content: I complained about my husband, but after talking with you, I feel okay about the housework and childcare. I've realized I was just feeling anxious about where his feelings truly lie.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: やはり
dialogue.content: Just as I thought...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: 1番辛いのは、やんや妖怪です
dialogue.content: The hardest thing is the Nag-Nag Monster.

dialogue.origin: やんや妖怪ですよね
dialogue.content: The Nag-Nag Monster, right.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: その味方として
dialogue.content: As an ally against it,

dialogue.origin: お医者戦士を投入してはどうかと思ったのです
dialogue.content: I was thinking we could bring in a “Doctor Warrior.”

dialogue.origin: 今のお医者様は、戦士になりえない
dialogue.content: Your current doctor might not be able to be that warrior.

dialogue.origin: お医者戦士！！
dialogue.content: A Doctor Warrior!!

dialogue.origin: あ！分かりました
dialogue.content: Ah! I get it.

dialogue.origin: ご相談者様の心のよりどころ
dialogue.content: A source of emotional support for you,

dialogue.origin: お医者戦士が味方にいれば、
dialogue.content: if you have a Doctor Warrior on your side,

dialogue.origin: 主人に家事など協力してもらい違う病院とお考えですかね
dialogue.content: Are you suggesting that I get my husband to help with chores so I can go to a different hospital?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます、お伝え不足で失礼しました。そうです。そうすれば、お医者戦士とグループで戦っていけるのではないかと
dialogue.content: Thank you, I apologize for not being clear. Yes, that's it. That way, you could fight as a team with your Doctor Warrior.

dialogue.origin: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: 相談員さん、ご提案ありがとうございますでも本当に家は田舎ですのであの病院以外で1番近くて往復8時間かかりますそれはそれで精神的、肉体的苦痛ですのであのわからんちん医者なら私にも、もっと気持ち分かって！と言えそうな気がしてきました私があの医者をお医者戦士に鍛えます！
dialogue.content: Counselor, thank you for the suggestion. But we live in a really rural area, so the next closest hospital is an 8-hour round trip. That would be its own mental and physical ordeal. So, with that stubborn doctor, I'm starting to feel like I can just tell him, 'You need to understand my feelings more!' I'm going to train that doctor into a Doctor Warrior myself!

dialogue.origin: 往復８時間！
dialogue.content: An eight-hour round trip!

dialogue.origin: 田舎なんです…
dialogue.content: We're in the countryside...

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか！
dialogue.content: I see!

dialogue.origin: お医者戦士に鍛えるなんて！なんと心強い！
dialogue.content: Training him into a Doctor Warrior! How empowering!

dialogue.origin: いえ
dialogue.content: Oh, no...

dialogue.origin: そして、ご相談者さん、ご自身を優しく抱きしめてあげてほしいんです。
dialogue.content: And also, I want you to give yourself a gentle hug.

dialogue.origin: 相談員さんが親身にこんな話しを聞いて頂けたおかげで何だか前向きに勇気がでましたし、他にも苦しい事あったのですが乗り越えて行けそうな気になりましあ
dialogue.content: Because you listened to me so compassionately, I somehow feel more positive and courageous. I've had other hardships, but now I feel like I can overcome them.

dialogue.origin: お医者戦士の提案ありがとうございました！！
dialogue.content: Thank you for the Doctor Warrior suggestion!!

dialogue.origin: それはよかったです！鏡の前で寝る前に「今日もよく頑張ったね」とご自身に声をかけてあげてください！
dialogue.content: I'm so glad to hear that! Before you go to sleep, stand in front of the mirror and tell yourself, 'You did a great job today.'

dialogue.origin: やんや妖怪に向かうためにも
dialogue.content: It will help you face the Nag-Nag Monster, too.

dialogue.origin: 照れますがやれそうな時やってみます
dialogue.content: It's embarrassing, but I'll try it when I feel I can.

dialogue.origin: ご自身の中にいる戦士や
dialogue.content: The warrior within you,

dialogue.origin: お医者戦士や
dialogue.content: the Doctor Warrior,

dialogue.origin: 3歳の小さな戦士を
dialogue.content: and your three-year-old little warrior—

dialogue.origin: 味方につけていきましょう！
dialogue.content: let's get them all on your side!

dialogue.origin: お優しく誠実なあなたならきっとできます！
dialogue.content: A kind and sincere person like you can definitely do it!

dialogue.origin: はい、今日はありがとうございました又、頑張れなくなった時、話し聞いて下さい
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much for today. When I feel like I can’t keep going, please listen to me again.

dialogue.origin: はい、またお待ちしていますね！
dialogue.content: Yes, I’ll be here for you again.

dialogue.origin: 心より応援しています！
dialogue.content: I'm rooting for you with all my heart!

dialogue.origin: 今日のご相談はここまでで大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Shall we wrap up for today?

dialogue.origin: （長い時間ありがとうございました。あなたさまでしたら、違うケースの話しで癒して頂きたかったです。今日は、本当のクライアントの様に癒され暖かく寄り添って頂けた事、感謝しております。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for the long session. With a counselor like you, I would have loved to be helped in a different case scenario as well. Today, I felt like a real client, and I'm grateful for how you healed and warmly supported me.)

dialogue.origin: はい、頑張りますありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, I’ll do my best. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: (こちらこそです！時間過ぎてしまいごめんなさい…。ありがとうございます！またおはなししましょう！)本日はご相談に来てくださりありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: (Likewise! I’m sorry we went over time… Thank you! Let’s talk again!) Thank you for coming to your consultation today.

dialogue.origin: （こちらこそありがとうございました。是非又、マッチング願ってます。その時はよろしくお願いいたします）
dialogue.content: (Thank you as well. I truly hope we’re matched again. I look forward to it.)

dialogue.origin: (大変励みになります、ありがとうございます！)
dialogue.content: (That’s very encouraging—thank you!)

dialogue.origin: （では又お会い出来る日を楽しみにしています。これにて失礼いたします。）
dialogue.content: (Then I'll look forward to the day we can meet again. I’ll take my leave now.)

dialogue.origin: (失礼します。それでは、終了いたします)
dialogue.content: (Goodbye. With that, I will end the session.)

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (Thank you.)
